settings.label: Free delivery threshold (EUR)
settings.info: Used by the cart, the bag drawer and every 'free delivery over' line on the site. Write [threshold] in the announcement bar or a collection FAQ answer to print this amount there too.

settings.label: Restricted product tag
settings.info: Products carrying this tag cannot be added to the bag in one click from a listing, a search result or a recommendation — the button becomes a link to the product page. Matching ignores capitals. Clear this field to disable the check.

settings.content: The dispatch cutoff appears beside the Add to bag button and in the cart. Leave it blank and no cutoff is shown anywhere — nothing unconfirmed goes next to a buy button. Note that 12 collection FAQ answers say "before 3pm" independently; check those before setting this.

settings.label: Same-day dispatch cutoff
settings.info: For example 3pm. Blank hides the line.

settings.content: Click & Collect needs no setting. It appears on a product automatically wherever Shopify local pickup is enabled for that product's location, and stays hidden otherwise, so the page cannot offer collection the store has not switched on.
Wording for the cookie consent banner. Turn OFF Shopify's own banner in Settings > Customer privacy > Cookie banner, or visitors will see two.

settings.label: Banner text
settings.default: We use cookies to run the shop, understand how it is used, and show you relevant offers. You can accept everything, reject everything, or choose. Cookies needed to run the shop are always on.
